verdict.rationale: Jev's docs state there is no fine-tuning by design: the same weights serve every account, and you shape answers through the request instead. TypeSafe's own weights are not published. The open-weight Hugging Face replicas are third-party reproductions, not vendor products, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune the vendor's models on my own data through a documented self-serve path — hosted fine-tuning API or tunable open weights
